title: Atrial Fibrillation Registry in Jordan
brief_summary: Prospective registry of all new comers with Atrial fibrillation
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Admission with atrial fibrillation
* developing atrial fibrillation during hospitalization for mon AF reason.
* age 18 or more years.
* patients welling to participate in the registry.

Exclusion Criteria:

* age less than 18 years.
* patients not welling to participate.
study_population: All new admissions with atrial fibrillation above the age of 18 or those who develop atrial fibrillation during hospitalization for non AF reason.
